title: PRC Value-Added Tax Law commences on 1 January 2026
summary: The PRC Value-Added Tax Law (adopted 25 December 2024) commences on 1 January 2026 and repeals the Provisional VAT Regulations. Art. 10 restates the 13%, 9%, 6%, and zero-rate bands. Art. 11 restates the 3% simplified collection rate. Art. 24 lists exemptions. The percentages of the general-method bands do not change on this date; the legal instrument does.

legal_basis.title: 中华人民共和国增值税法
legal_basis.instrument: 中华人民共和国增值税法（2024年12月25日第十四届全国人大常委会第十三次会议通过）第十条、第十一条、第二十四条、第三十八条
legal_basis.pinpoint: 第十条（一）13%（二）9%（三）6%（四）出口货物税率为零（五）跨境服务/无形资产零税率；第十一条 简易计税征收率3%；第三十八条 自2026年1月1日起施行，《增值税暂行条例》同时废止

changes.summary: VAT Law Art. 10 restates the 13%, 9%, 6%, and zero-rate bands, and Art. 11 restates the 3% simplified collection rate, from 1 January 2026.

migration_impact.summary: Invoice and filing systems keep the same general-method percentages but should cite the VAT Law from 1 January 2026. The Provisional Regulations are repealed on that date. Confirm any implementing-rule changes that the Law leaves to the State Council.

after.description: VAT Law Arts. 10, 11 and 24 in force; Provisional Regulations repealed.
